passages.question: What goes on the Schedule B sent with the reply?
passages.excerpt: On Schedule B, list your tax liability for each day. Your tax liability is based on the dates wages were paid. ... Don't use Schedule B to show federal tax deposits. ... If you have been assessed a failure-to-deposit (FTD) penalty, you may be able to file an amended Schedule B. ... The IRS will refigure the penalty and notify you of any change in the penalty.
